title: Callvale before: the upload waits for the worker
claim: The web application calls the one worker and waits, so when the worker is busy, the upload fails.
alt: Before: customers upload recordings to the web tier. The web application calls the single worker directly and waits. Scheduled jobs on the same worker save results and send notifications. Job status is in the PostgreSQL database.

edges.label: upload
edges.say: A customer uploads a recording to the web application.

edges.label: call, wait
edges.say: The web application calls the worker and waits for it to finish.

edges.label: also runs
edges.say: Scheduled jobs on the same worker save results and send notifications.

edges.label: upload fails
edges.say: When the worker is overloaded, the upload request fails.
